response.sql: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_ratios), first_group AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS above_overall FROM patient_ratios p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM first_group) SELECT AVG(f.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(f.above_overall) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(f.ratio - g.avg_ratio) AS avg_above_group FROM first_group f CROSS JOIN group_average g WHERE f.ratio > g.avg_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: A patient's ratio is the average of their valid lab test ratios; tests with missing HGB or HCT, or zero HCT, are excluded. Patients with no valid ratio are excluded from the averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate each patient's ratio by dividing their average HGB by their average HCT, using tests with both measurements present and nonzero HCT.
alternatives.sql: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_ratios), first_group AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS above_overall FROM patient_ratios p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM first_group) SELECT AVG(f.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(f.above_overall) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(f.ratio - g.avg_ratio) AS avg_above_group FROM first_group f CROSS JOIN group_average g WHERE f.ratio > g.avg_ratio;
